title: Implement device health and configuration jobs

environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-DEV-004-AC01.finding: Health polling updates the real device record's last-seen, status, health detail and check timestamp, and the web workflow renders the change.

BIO-DEV-004-AC02.finding: Remote jobs are gated by certification, adapter availability, category capability and the separate execute permission before audit or execution.

BIO-DEV-004-AC03.finding: Configuration, firmware and reboot jobs write the shared audit event before execution, using only the provenance-verified header actor.

BIO-DEV-004-AC04.finding: Uncertified combinations, missing adapters and unsupported job types fail with distinct explicit errors; unsupported options cannot be selected in the UI.

BIO-DEV-004-AC05.finding: The additive /devices panel covers list, poll, capabilities, supported job success and explicit failure; real-host tests cover the same backend path with authorization and audit.

commands.result: PASS (builder evidence 6/6 three times); acceptance replay blocked by managed sandbox EPERM on 127.0.0.1:3000

follow_ups.summary: BIO-DEV-001 registration and BIO-DEV-003 capability/health routes remain ungated inherited scope; this acceptance covers only DEV-004's four newly owned routes.
Vendor adapters currently expose no remote-admin calls, so execution is deterministic simulation behind the production capability/audit seam.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC05 pass. The Critical unauthenticated remote-control gap is closed on all four story-owned routes by verified provenance, split tenant permissions and verified audit attribution, with exact-commit independent review.
